schema_note: Documentazione MDAC, NON JSON importabile in Elementor; applicare in Site Settings > Global Fonts dopo verifica versione.
delivery: Self-hosted files obtained from Google Fonts; configure exact Google Fonts families in Elementor UI; avoid activating a second parallel loader.
responsive_typography: Refer to elementor-design-system.json and page CSS; values vary by component; do not replace all headings with a single global clamp.
warning: Do not load API CSS and self-hosted CSS simultaneously; decide loading strategy per WP environment.
